answer: Both figures are right; they divide by different things. The agency's 5.4% is total interactions divided by total reach (the account rate by reach is 5.39%). The calculator's 0.67% is average likes and comments per post divided by 8,400 followers. Against its own previous 90 days, Instagram's account rate by reach went down from 5.68% to 5.39%, and LinkedIn's went down from 6.78% to 6.14%. Against benchmarks that use the same formula, Instagram is in line by reach (4.56% median per post without saves against Buffer's 5.5%) and above by followers (0.74% against Quid's 0.30% median). LinkedIn is below by impressions (3.7% against Socialinsider's 5.20% average) and in line by reach with clicks added (7.55% against Buffer's 6.2% median). TikTok had 8 videos, too few to grade.
